name: GetWindow
label: Get Window
description: Finds a desktop window by name using UI Automation.

fields.name: WindowName
fields.label: Window Name
fields.description: The name (title) of the window to find.

fields.name: MatchMode
fields.label: Name Match Mode
fields.description: How to match the window name. Options: Equals, Contains, Starts With.

selectOptions.label: Contains
selectOptions.description: Match if the name contains the specified text.

selectOptions.label: Starts With
selectOptions.description: Match if the name starts with the specified text.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for the window (in seconds).

fields.name: WindowElement
fields.label: Automation Element
fields.description: The found AutomationElement for the window.
